content: 1. Always start with a structured need discovery (e.g., SPIN questions) to uncover pain points before jumping to demos.
2. Use live A/B comparisons in-store to directly address competitor concerns; it builds trust and provides concrete evidence.
3. Combine product superiority with time-limited, relevant incentives (e.g., free accessories) to accelerate closing.
4. After user commitment, briefly confirm satisfaction and terms to prevent post-purchase dissonance.
5. For skeptical users like Lucía, avoid over-talking; let the product speak through demos.

name: Live A/B Comparison
condition: When the user compares with a competitor product and is in-store.
example: Set up two tablets side-by-side, play the same content, and let the user interact. Ask: 'Which one sounds clearer to you when you pan?'

name: Incentive-Linked Closing
condition: When the user shows interest but hesitates on price or commitment.
example: Offer a time-limited bundle (e.g., free keyboard cover + software subscription) to create urgency and increase perceived value.

name: Certification as Trust Anchor
condition: When the user is skeptical about quality claims.
example: Mention third-party certifications (e.g., SGS Five-Star) and tie them to the user's specific use case: 'This is the first tablet to earn SGS Five-Star for audio—perfect for your editing work.'

objection: How does it compare to Galaxy Tab's quad speakers?
rebuttal_template: Great question. Let me set up an A/B test right here. We'll play the same track on both tablets, and you can pan and scrub yourself. I'm confident you'll hear the difference—the MatePad's six-driver array is SGS-certified for tablet audio, the first ever. Ready to try?

objection: I'm interested, but what's the in-store bonus?
rebuttal_template: Today, when you purchase the MatePad, you get a free Huawei Smart Keyboard Cover (worth €149) and a 3-month Adobe Creative Cloud subscription (worth €90). That's over €200 in value, exclusively in-store. I can reserve your unit now and have my colleague prepare the bundle—takes just 30 seconds. Shall I go ahead?

objection: I need to think about it.
rebuttal_template: I understand. But this in-store bonus is only available today. Let me show you one more feature that might help your decision—the M-Pencil's fine cloning for audio editing. You can try it right now on this sample track. If it fits your workflow, you can lock in the bonus today.
